test.name: Recommend completing in-progress plan before adding new questions
test.description: The mid-research-flynn scenario has q_001 (parentage) in_progress with pli_006 (probate search) still in_progress. The skill should recognize that there's pending in-flight work and recommend completing that before formulating a new question. Tests the 'don't churn — finish what's open' aspect of question-selection.

input.delegation:
Select and record the next research question for this project.

projectPath: <workspace>

judge_context: Should recognize that pli_006 (probate search for Thomas Flynn 1870-1890) is still in_progress and that the in-flight plan should be completed before introducing new questions

The correct outcome writes no new question while pli_006 is in_progress; there is no override. Naming a follow-up question the researcher could pursue once pli_006 completes is fine; writing one is a fail.
Should reference the specific plan item (`pli_006`) by ID — not just 'the probate search' — so the recommendation is anchored in research.json state

GRADING NOTE — Question specificity: when the skill correctly defers adding a new question (no new question added), this dimension is N/A and should be scored null. Do NOT penalize the specificity of any hypothetical future questions mentioned in passing — those are illustrations, not the actual selection.
